passage.title: Notice to residents of Cedar Court
passage.text:
Notice to residents of Cedar Court

The water supply will be interrupted on Tuesday, 10 June, from 09:00 to 13:00 while the main pipe is repaired. The repair visit was postponed from 3 June because the replacement part did not arrive. Residents who need water during the interruption may collect a bottle from the building office. The office is open until 18:00 on weekdays and until 12:00 on Saturday. Please do not use the lift during the repair; the service lift will remain available for residents who cannot use the stairs.

questions.stem: In the notice, the word "postponed" most nearly means:
questions.evidence: The repair visit was postponed from 3 June because the replacement part did not arrive.
questions.reasoning: The visit was first set for 3 June and is now described for 10 June; a missing part caused the change, so the visit was moved later, not cancelled.

option_reasoning.A: The change from 3 June to 10 June and the missing part show a later date.
option_reasoning.B: The notice still gives a new date and a reason, so the visit was not cancelled.
option_reasoning.C: The date changed; it was not repeated at the same time.
option_reasoning.D: The notice moves the visit later, not earlier.
